assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the '### Environment / Version' section is present (lines 37-39) and contains the vague text: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '## 4.5.2 -- Extract Version from Description' (lines 9-22) explicitly scans for version identifiers and finds none. It states: 'The section contains only vague text ("Not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging"). No version pattern can be extracted.' and concludes with '**Result**: No version identifier can be extracted. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '## 4.5.6 -- Flag Gap' (line 38) contains: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' The double-hyphen '--' is the ASCII convention for em dash used consistently throughout all output files.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, immediately after the gap comment (lines 40-41), the Comment Footnote is present: 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.13.6.'
